card.title: Nintendo Wii Green light but no audio and black screen, red flash

source.title: Nintendo Wii Green light but no audio and black screen, red flash

symptoms: green light, black screen, no audio

claims.statement: A Wii that powers on to a black screen with no audio usually has the Bluetooth or Wi-Fi board disconnected or failed; reseat/inspect, then replace (Bluetooth first, then Wi-Fi).

procedure: Reseat the Bluetooth board; inspect pins.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
